release.inspection: Official DMG downloaded, SHA-256 matched release API digest, mounted read-only without opening app, version/build/revision read from Info.plist. Application not launched.

measurement_boundaries.pty_byte_echo: Not applicable to native GUI; CLI command acknowledgement is not terminal rendering.
measurement_boundaries.native_startup: Unmeasured: launch to owned-workspace readiness, not process creation or socket existence.
measurement_boundaries.native_memory: Unmeasured: must distinguish main app RSS, helper/process-tree RSS and physical footprint; not comparable to server-only RSS.
measurement_boundaries.input_to_pixel: Unmeasured: requires a presentation receipt or controlled visual instrumentation; no timing inferred from socket acknowledgement.

isolation_review.supported_route: Upstream tagged Release staging changes bundle identity, socket and daemon socket, ad-hoc signs the copied app, then invokes open -g.
isolation_review.blocker: The inspected release's startup calls scheduleInitialMainWindowBootstrap -> bootstrapInitialMainWindowIfNeeded with shouldActivate defaulting true. createMainWindow uses runningApplication([activateAllWindows]) and respectActivationSuppression:false. open -g alone therefore does not prove non-activation. No native launch was attempted on the user's active GUI session.
isolation_review.state_warning: Upstream staging script resolves account home via getpwuid for discovery markers; changing HOME alone does not isolate all macOS preferences/state.
isolation_review.required_environment: Separate macOS login/VM or explicitly available dedicated GUI test session, unique staging bundle identity, owned sockets/state/workspace, no global accessibility changes.
